■ Stage Direction
Unable to hold it in, spoken instinctively
—Can you take responsibility for that?

Too bad... because if you ask me, "support"
is nothing more than "leaving it to someone else."
Huh?

That's why she wanted a Trainer she didn't have to obey.
—A Trainer like me, who couldn't assert their own will properly.

Fierce rejection with a subtle trace of anger.
Though overwhelmed by her intimidating presence—I clenched my fist tightly.

If I just keep obeying her blindly, whether the outcome is good or bad,
she'll be forced to bear the full burden all by herself. That simply... won't do.

And there was one more thing I realized—
I was chosen as her Trainer precisely because I wouldn't clash with her convictions.

—I want to change. I want to become a Trainer who can speak with her as an equal and hear her dreams.
If there's anything I can do toward that end... I'm willing to work for it.

I'm the one holding the leash. I might give you orders,
but it never goes the other way around. I already taught you that, didn't I?

Or what? You got business with us?
Ha, as if—

Hah! I see, I see.
What a grand, beautiful piece of idealism.

So—Rudolf. You'd know if you listened, but
this girl chose of her own free will to "push past her limits and see it through."

............
I understand both of your feelings very well.

To achieve that, I first need to earn the right to speak with her—
the right to "sit at the table." The way to do that is...
...However—

You string together all those sweet words to get her to trust you...
And what happens if she doesn't get the outcome she wanted?

Willpower is the one and only thing...
that no one can ever control.

Whatever the "happiest future" is... nobody else gets to decide that for you.
—Only you yourself do.

You're... Sirius-senpai's. Haaah... What do you want?
You can see for yourself, can't you? Senpai's not here today.

However, I have no intention of stopping my efforts to persuade her.
I intend to do everything in my power so that she may grasp the happiest future possible.

In my view, there are plenty of things to be done before taking such risks.
For instance, one-on-one training with an instructor.

...Yeah, she thought it through with her own head and chose her answer.
You got a problem with that?
Step back.

Huh, Sirius-senpai...!?
Um—

What a boundless proposition. Responsibility isn't a quick fix for the moment.
It affects everything in the future ahead. That's why you carry it yourself.

I'm weak... so if I rely on someone else,
and things don't work out... I know I'll end up blaming them for everything.

I can't hide my shock at those ominous words.
Is that junior really pushing herself to such an extreme in her training...?

What do you say to focusing on a long-term plan like this?
Naturally, I will oversee everything and provide my full support—

No, I have no intention of denying her will.
However, I cannot agree with risking her ability to run in the future.

Sirius Symboli, who had been standing next to me just moments ago,
stepped right between the two of them as if she couldn't take it anymore...!

Ah...! I was really happy that
you cared so much, President... But I still... have to decide for myself.

Thanks for the polite invitation.
But that was a one-time exception.

...If she gives it her absolute all and still fails to achieve results,
then of course, I will take responsibility. That is precisely why I became Student Council President.

Even so, I gave it everything I had just to run on the stage of my dreams!
As long as I take full responsibility for it myself, I know... I won't have any regrets.

...Then let's see it.
What you can grasp—with those trembling hands of yours.

Revising dietary menus for more efficient body conditioning.
Conducting periodic checkups on physical and mental fatigue.

You'll keep obeying me going forward.
...You got that drilled into your head, right?
...Hey, what are you standing around there for?

What she values above all else is the act of "choosing."
And at the same time, she despises "submitting."

I broke the chain. Biting back or tucking your tail and running—
the rest is up to you to "choose."

—Hyahaha!
Whoa, whoa, you missed it completely... Hm?

—That's right, a match. Whoever loses does what the other says.
Simple enough rules, right?

—Listening to Sirius Symboli,
I finally understood why she is always overflowing with such absolute confidence.
A few days later—
